### Celsius Holdings to Release Third Quarter Results on Thursday, Nov. 5, 2026


October 29, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/427437840/files/doc_news/Celsius-Holdings-to-Release-Third-Quarter-Results-on-Thursday-Nov--5-2026-2026.pdf)


BOCA RATON, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Celsius Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CELH) will release its third quarter financial results before markets open on Thursday, Nov. 5, 2026. Following the release, management will host a conference call and webcast at 8 a.m. ET to discuss the company’s third quarter results.


Investors are invited to join the webcast accessible from[https://ir.celsiusholdingsinc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.celsiusholdingsinc.com&esheet=54630846&newsitemid=20261029311488&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fir.celsiusholdingsinc.com&index=1&md5=0c7fae41ddc65ad868db37d832fa1a9b) . Downloadable files, an audio replay and transcript will be available after the call on the Celsius Holdings investor relations website.


**About Celsius Holdings, Inc.**


Celsius Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: CELH) is a global functional beverage company and the owner of energy drink brand CELSIUS®, wellness brand Alani Nu® and the North American Rockstar® Energy brand. Born in fitness and pioneering the rapidly growing functional beverage category, the company creates and markets leading functional beverage products. For more information, please visit[www.celsiusholdingsinc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.celsiusholdingsinc.com&esheet=54630846&newsitemid=20261029311488&lan=en-US&anchor=www.celsiusholdingsinc.com&index=2&md5=6f4573125e68c7d613086db656d6d6c7) .
